It should define a function that runs the simulation. In this function, it should import additional modules, set up the kernel, load the geometry from a file, import constants, and configure the Geant4 interface. It should also set up the tracking field, event actions, and the particle gun. The code should handle simulation particles, build the physics list, and start the engine. If the script is run as the main program, it should call the function to run the simulation.

DD4hepSimulation, get_code, importConstants, import_geometry, enableDetailedHitsAndParticleInfo, _set, compileAClick, get_unbound_function, _setKernelProperty, makeSet, setOption, setOptions, run, import_rec, _import_class, import_detail, import_tgeo, import_units, _import_module, import_root

```python
import logging
from dd4hep.simulation import DD4hepSimulation, setOption, setOptions, run
from dd4hep.simulation import import_geometry, importConstants, enableDetailedHitsAndParticleInfo
from dd4hep.simulation import _setKernelProperty

logging.basicConfig(level=logging.INFO)
logger = logging.getLogger("dd4hep_simulation")

def run_dd4hep_simulation():
    # Import additional modules
    from dd4hep.simulation import import_units, import_tgeo, import_root
    from dd4hep.simulation import _import_module

    logger.info("Initializing DD4hep simulation kernel...")
    sim = DD4hepSimulation()

    # Set up the kernel
    _setKernelProperty("Simulation", sim)

    # Load geometry from file
    geometry_file = "detector.xml"
    logger.info(f"Importing geometry from {geometry_file}...")
    import_geometry(geometry_file)

    # Import constants
    logger.info("Importing constants...")
    importConstants("constants.xml")

    # Configure Geant4 interface
    logger.info("Configuring Geant4 interface...")
    setOption("Geant4Run", "PhysicsList", "FTFP_BERT")
    setOption("Geant4Run", "RangeCut", 0.1)

    # Set up tracking field
    logger.info("Setting up tracking field...")
    setOption("Geant4Field", "FieldType", "Uniform")
    setOption("Geant4Field", "FieldValue", [0.0, 0.0, 2.0])

    # Set up event actions
    logger.info("Configuring event actions...")
    setOption("EventAction", "Enable", True)
    setOption("EventAction", "Verbose", 1)

    # Set up particle gun
    logger.info("Setting up particle gun...")
    setOption("ParticleGun", "Particle", "e-")
    setOption("ParticleGun", "Energy", 10.0)
    setOption("ParticleGun", "Direction", [0, 0, 1])
    setOption("ParticleGun", "Position", [0, 0, 0])

    # Handle simulation particles
    logger.info("Enabling detailed hits and particle info...")
    enableDetailedHitsAndParticleInfo()

    # Build the physics list
    logger.info("Building physics list...")
    setOption("PhysicsList", "Name", "FTFP_BERT")

    # Start the engine
    logger.info("Starting simulation engine...")
    run()

if __name__ == "__main__":
    run_dd4hep_simulation()
```
